items.name: Cube Challenge Quark 2018

venue.name: BITS Pilani K K Birla Goa Campus
venue.address: BITS Pilani K K Birla Goa Campus,NH 17 B, Zuarinagar

items.information:
Online Registration closes on 6th February at 23:59 IST. 
Your registration will only be confirmed after you have made your payment online. 
For online registration it is mandotry to register online on WCA and make the payment.
*On the spot Registration* will be available from 8:00 to 9:00 AM on day of the competition at the venue.
Please check the[ Registration Procedure and Accomodation tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeChallengeQuark2018#3777-registration-procedure-and-accomodation) for detailed instructions.
Check the [Schedule tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeChallengeQuark2018#3778-schedule) for the competition schedule and Cutoffs&Timelimits.
**Please carry an ID proof with you on day of the event.**

items.name: Johor Cube Open 2018

venue.address: Jalan Bertingkat Skudai, Taman Perusahaan Ringan Pulai, 81300 Skudai, Johor, Malaysia

items.information:
**Registration info**
* Registration opens on Monday, 15th January, 12:00am (GMT+8).
* The steps for registration are as follows:
1. [Register ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/JohorCubeOpen2018/register)
2. [Pay](https://www.mycubeassociation.com/payment-johor-cube-open-2018) according the events you registered.
3. Once we have confirmed correct payment, we will accept your registration.

**In order to complete your registration please proceed with the payment according to the events registered. Payment which does not match with the event registered will be recognise as 'Incomplete registration'
